name: deepscientist-lite
description: Teaching-first DeepScientist Lite workflow plugin for Codex with file-led research maps, memory cards, artifacts, and a tiny adjacency-list state kernel.

interface.shortDescription: Run a lightweight DeepScientist-style research workflow inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: DeepScientist Lite compresses the teachable core of DeepScientist into Codex skills, templates, and a small local state-graph script. It keeps research work file-led and artifact-first without requiring the DeepScientist daemon, Web/TUI, connectors, MCP servers, or local model deployment.
defaultPrompt: $ds-lite-intake start a research project from this question
$ds-lite-scout audit the literature and baseline route
$ds-lite-experiment record this experiment in the research map
